evidence.title: Building data-driven design systems · Ky Decker

name: Building data-driven design systems
summary: Case study on scaling Scribe's design system with surveys and metrics, serving over 6 million users.
description: Personal write-up by Ky Decker, Scribe's first design engineer, about running Scribe's design system from June 2024 to April 2026. It explains the survey questions used to track adoption, predictability, naming, time savings, documentation and collaboration, the results after 18 months, and the lessons drawn from them.
